## Latest Release

### Version 0.3.2 (July 2026)

- **New features**:
  - Flexible filename↔metadata matching: extension and case are now ignored when linking images to metadata rows
  - Scale can now be entered as a ratio (e.g., `1:2`) in addition to a decimal factor
  - "Show sort value as chapter title": prints the current Primary Sort value once per group, right-aligned in the page margin
  - Table number label is now inset from the page border when Show Margin Border is enabled
  - "Bottom Right" added as an Object Numbering position
  - Loading overlay shown while images are uploading, so the app no longer looks stuck on large batches


## Version History

### Version 0.3.1 (December 2025)

- **New features**:
  - Added Pixel
  - Object numbering

### Version 0.3.0 (December 2025)

**Key Features:**

-   Improved SVG export
-   Data handling optimizations
-   Upgraded preview rendering


### Version 0.2.0 (December 2025)

**Key Features:**

-   New Web Interface: Modern browser-based UI
-   Standalone Executable: Windows .exe with no dependencies
-   Drag & Drop Upload: Easy image management
-   Live Preview: See layout before exporting
-   Download Manager: Get results as ZIP or individual files
-   Improved Paths: Files saved next to executable for easy access
